Agent Name: Clinical_Trial_Data_Analysis_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The first substantive error was made when this agent claimed to have “successfully located” the trial and reported an actual enrollment of 100 participants. The problem is that the conversation provides no real evidence that the NIH/ClinicalTrials.gov page was actually accessed and verified, and the enrollment value appears to be unsubstantiated. The later “verification” step simply repeated and accepted the same information without independent validation, so the initial unsupported claim by the Clinical_Trial_Data_Analysis_Expert is the direct source of the likely wrong solution.
